channel.title: PkgWatch: high-risk suspicious packages on npm and PyPI
channel.description: PkgWatch statically analyses newly published npm and PyPI packages and lists the ones that look suspicious. Entries are leads for human review, not verdicts.

item.title: [HIGH 100] suspicious pypi package: spellwarden 1.17.0
item.description:
Risk score 100/100 (high).

  • Code decodes or unpacks a hidden payload and executes it.
  • Code downloads a file and then executes it or marks it executable.
  • Compiled executable or library in a package that is not declared as native.

Registry page · Report a false positive

item.title: [HIGH 80] suspicious pypi package: pyqcd 0.5.1
item.description:
Risk score 80/100 (high).

  • setup.py subprocess.run() starts a process at install time.
  • Recently created package from a publisher with little history, with a name similar to popular package 'pyocd'.
  • setup.py writes a file outside the build directory at install time.
  • Name is 1 edit(s) from popular package 'pyocd' (one character substituted).
  • Long base64 or hex blob embedded in source code.

Registry page · Report a false positive

item.title: [HIGH 74] suspicious npm package: @tiledesk/tiledesk-server 3.3.5
item.description:
Risk score 74/100 (high).

  • Hardcoded request-capture service in package code.
  • URL with a raw IP address instead of a hostname.
  • 'preinstall' script runs automatically at install time.
  • Long high-entropy string literal (entropy above 5.0 bits per character).
